decisions.reason: The necessary height-hierarchy impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the E/L alignment to the second V's left arm and the right arm rising above them.
Changing the E and L cap height does not alter their shared baseline or the lower-point alignment of the Vs.
The source keeps the second V unchanged and scales the E and L around it, so its proportional derivation and right-arm construction remain valid.
The E/L height adjustment does not change kerning values or cadence rules; the separate Variation B selection is already represented in this candidate's history.
The source uses the second V's left arm as an E/L height reference and does not modify the Hero V's geometry.
The request to verify the accent reaffirms its existing literal-copy rule and does not change its derivation state.
The explicit E/L scaling request is compatible with varying the element currently under review and does not change the locked-assets list or revision policy.
The source does not change the required peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
The letter-height refinement has no effect on the deferred champagne material treatment.
Selecting and refining a presented variation does not change the already requested comparison-proof format or dimensions.
Scaling the E and L does not change the all-caps case treatment.
The source's geometric refinement does not alter the requirement to provide a short rationale with each design round.
